# lsp-llms

> Structured English documentation for LSP — Linguagem Senior de Programação
> (Senior Programming Language), transformed from community documentation for
> LLM and coding-agent consumption.

This file is generated by `scripts/build_llms.py`. Do not edit manually.

Orientation:

- The pages below are the source of truth for documented LSP behavior.
- Respect the evidence labels used across the corpus (`Source-faithful`,
  `Excerpt`, `Demonstrated`, `Observed-only`, `Project guidance`,
  `Conflict / uncertainty`); see the Evidence vocabulary in `docs/index.md`.
- Conflicts are preserved explicitly, never silently resolved; follow the
  safest documented pattern and verify against official Senior documentation.
- Senior Sistemas is the authoritative source for official product behavior.

## Language core

- [Syntax and structure](docs/language/syntax.md): available. Statement termination, case sensitivity, code blocks, conditions in parentheses, comments, escaping, line continuation, formatting conventions.
- [Variables, data types, declarations, and naming](docs/language/variables.md): available. Documented types, `Definir` syntax, sized `Alfa`, name constraints, `va`/`vn`/`vd` convention, declaration placement, initialization guidance.
- [Control flow](docs/language/control-flow.md): available. `Se`/`Senao`, `Para`, `Enquanto`, `Pare`, `Continue`, `VaPara` with labels. Includes recorded conflicts and explicitly undocumented behaviors.
- [Arrays and indexed values](docs/language/arrays.md): available. Bracket declarations, indexed assignment/reads, iteration, 0-based vs 1-based evidence. Centers on the unresolved `Alfa[N]` sized-string vs. array conflict.
- [Lista, Tabela, and Grid](docs/language/collections.md): available. `Lista` command API and navigation (direct-return 1/0), `ListaRegra*` core (`"S"`/`"N"`), `Tabela` declaration/access, `GerTab*`/Grid evidence boundaries. Full rule-list catalog deferred.

## Guides

- [Critical limitations and common pitfalls](docs/guides/limitations.md): available. Output-parameter calls, no-manipulation-in-parameters rule, `Mensagem` rules and payload ban, grid/table and `SQL_Retornar` restrictions, concatenation/type rules, `Truncar`, date pitfalls, non-existent constructs, `Cancel` contexts. Includes recorded documentation conflicts.

## Functions

- [String functions](docs/functions/strings.md): available. Concatenation, extraction, measurement, search, substitution, insertion, deletion, whitespace, case, accent/special-character, line-splitting, delimited lists, ASCII and encoding conversion, math on `Alfa`. Conversions (`IntParaAlfa`, `AlfaParaInt`, …) documented in `functions/conversion.md`.
- [Date and time functions](docs/functions/dates-time.md): available. Current date/time, construction, decomposition, formatting, demonstrated arithmetic and comparison, weekday/business-day functions. Includes recorded conflicts (output types, literals, masks).
- [Type conversion functions](docs/functions/conversion.md): available. Evidence-only conversion matrix, Alfa/Numero/Data/masked/hour-minute conversions, observed-only date helpers, failure catalog. Intuitive names (`NumeroParaAlfa`, `AlfaParaNumero`) confirmed absent.
- [Numeric and math functions](docs/functions/numeric-math.md): available. Operators subset, truncation, rounding (ABNT as stated), Delphi-style formatting, value-to-words, unit multiplication/conversion, division helpers. Name-variant conflicts preserved.

## Database

- [Cursors and SQL](docs/database/cursors-sql.md): available. Simple vs. complete cursors, lifecycle, placeholders and binds, returned columns, BOF/EOF navigation, `SelecaoTabelas`, `ExecSQL`/`ExecSQLEx`, transactions, SQL Senior 2 mode. Dynamic-SQL contradiction preserved.

## I/O

- [File operations](docs/io/files.md): available. Handle-based text I/O, whole-file loading, existence checks, line counting, temp files. Open-mode and `ArqExiste` conflicts preserved; encoding/newlines undocumented.

## Data

- [JSON handling](docs/data/json.md): available. `Alfa` representation, `ValorElementoJson` single-field reads, `ListaRegraCarregarJson` collections, manual string scanning. Indexed paths rejected; no builder API; null/boolean undocumented.

## Integration

- [HTTP and web services](docs/integration/http-webservices.md): available. `Http*` helpers (verbs, headers, status, cookies, proxy, SSL, timeout, download, auth), Senior WS ports with grids. Expression-in-parameter contradictions preserved.

## Not yet documented

- Operators
- Function definitions and calls (beyond the control-flow and limitations excerpts)
- Validation and security functions (string, date, conversion, numeric, and database functions are done)
- Rule lists (core `ListaRegra` in collections; full catalog deferred)
- Report Generator functions
- Files and HTTP/Web-Service integration (file operations and HTTP/web-services are done)
- User interface (`Mensagem`, `EntradaValor`, `Cancel`)
- System variables and execution contexts
- Worked examples, patterns, and remaining troubleshooting (beyond the guardrail subset in the limitations guide)

## Limitations and conflicts

- [Critical limitations and common pitfalls](docs/guides/limitations.md): available. Output-parameter calls, no-manipulation-in-parameters rule, `Mensagem` rules and payload ban, grid/table and `SQL_Retornar` restrictions, concatenation/type rules, `Truncar`, date pitfalls, non-existent constructs, `Cancel` contexts. Includes recorded documentation conflicts.
- Every domain page records its own conflicts and uncertainties explicitly; follow the safest documented pattern.
